messages:
incident-bot: [P1] Degraded inference for SolaceBank (tenant: solace-001) in vpc-us-east-1 dedicated pool. Elevated 5xxs and timeouts observed for model 'redwood/grok-13b-v1'. Auto-escalation: paging oncall. Triggered 2026-03-17T12:03:41Z

sanjay (oncall): acked. pulling logs + tracing. paging ENG-SRE and ENG-ML.

mike (eng-sre): on it. initial look: kv-cache eviction spikes then RPC errors to pods on pool-d-12. grabbing pod logs now.

anna (eng-ml): fyi this model had a small weight merge yesterday (grok-13b-v1.1) — could be unstable under certain sequence lengths. we have a safe variant 'grok-13b-v1-safe' and previous stable tag 'grok-13b-v0.9'.

leah (acct): I'm spinning up a war room with SolaceBank CSM, will notify them we're investigating and may apply an engineered fallback. want to confirm mitigation plan before telling them manually.

mike (eng-sre): logs: ```
ERROR kvcache: miss ratio 0.78
WARN rpc: connect timeout to inference-worker-12 (10.1.4.22)
5xx handler: OutOfMemoryError? (heap spike observed)
```

sanjay (oncall): options: 1) pin tenant to grok-13b-v0.9 immediately (fastest, known-good), 2) route to safe variant grok-13b-v1-safe (minimal regression, slightly lower perf), 3) scale pool / reprovision (slower). prefer 1+2 combo: pin and route 100% to safe variant or pin to older model. advice from ENG-ML?

anna (eng-ml): I recommend applying the safe variant first (non-disruptive) then if errors persist pin to v0.9. Safe variant has identical API surface; perf delta ~+12ms median. We can push a tenant override via admin API.

mike (eng-sre): ready to execute. sample admin call (runbook):

```
POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/tenants/solace-001/overrides
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "override_reason": "active incident - model fallback to safe variant",
  "route": {
    "model": "redwood/grok-13b-v1-safe",
    "percent": 100,
    "pin": true,
    "expires_in": "1h"
  }
}
```

devops-bot: Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/infrastructure/runbooks/tenant-model-override

leah (acct): SolaceBank is on a billable dedicated contract. will tell them we're applying conservative fallback to preserve availability; they'll be expecting a follow-up note. assigning CSM: @julia.

ryan (pager): I can take the exec to deploy. handing to me in 5m. after deploy I'll monitor 1m/5m error rates and CPU on pool.

sanjay (oncall): mike / ryan coordinate. I'll sit on thread and update timeline to support and CSM. if safe variant doesn't return baseline in 10m we escalate to pin to v0.9 and notify customer of rollback risk.

mike (eng-sre): executing override now. running curl to admin API...

mike (eng-sre): ``curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"override_reason":"active incident","route":{"model":"redwood/grok-13b-v1-safe","percent":100,"pin":true,"expires_in":"1h"}}' https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/tenants/solace-001/overrides``

mike (eng-sre): response: 202 Accepted. override id: ov-20260317-77a9.

ryan (pager): monitoring: error rate dropped from 4.8% -> 0.9% in 90s. latency stable. CPU normals.

anna (eng-ml): checking outputs for quality regressions on sanity set. sampling looks fine (short prompt tests). no hallucination spike.

leah (acct): message to SolaceBank sent: "We applied a conservative fallback to preserve availability; we will follow up with full incident report and remediation timeline." CSM confirmed.

sanjay (oncall): 10m mark check: errors at 0.7%, target <1%. safe variant holding. decision: maintain override and monitor for 30m, then lift pin and perform controlled canary of v1.1 after postmortem.

mike (eng-sre): filing incident ticket: INC-2026-032-0043, linking override ov-20260317-77a9 and pod logs.

anna (eng-ml): note for postmortem: investigate weight merge for v1.1 under long-context workloads; consider rollback of the merge and add gated canary for model merges targeting dedicated pools.

ryan (pager): handing off active monitoring to night oncall (sanjay -> ryan -> tayla). tayla notified. I'll leave heartbeat messages every 10m in thread.

devops-bot: Incident actions logged: INC-2026-032-0043. Override applied: ov-20260317-77a9. Notifying compliance logs and KMS audit.

sanjay (oncall): thanks team. closing pager escalation if no regressions in 30m. I'll draft communications and assign postmortem owners (mike + anna).

incident-bot: RESOLVED (monitoring): Safe variant applied, error rate returned to baseline. Incident state moved to monitoring. Follow-up: postmortem assigned INC-2026-032-0043 -> owners: mike, anna.
